S024.name: Depressed_Mood
S024.description: A state where a sad, empty, or hopeless mood persists.

subtypes.Depressed Mood: A persistently sunken mood or feeling of depression.
subtypes.Tearfulness: A state of frequent crying or inability to hold back tears.
subtypes.Sadness: A state where a sad or gloomy mood is maintained continuously.
subtypes.Emptiness: A feeling of inner emptiness or a state of feeling no emotion.
subtypes.Emotional Numbness: A state where emotions feel dulled or paralyzed.

S029.name: Fatigue
S029.description: Persistent fatigue that is not relieved by rest and a marked lack of energy.

subtypes.Chronic Fatigue: Fatigue that persists for a long period even after adequate rest.
subtypes.Physical Fatigue: A state of physical exhaustion where the body feels heavy and easily tires even from minor activities.
subtypes.Mental Fatigue: A state where fatigue accumulates rapidly during the process of thinking or concentrating.
subtypes.Loss of Energy: Difficulty performing daily activities due to a decline in energy and vitality.

S083.name: Hopelessness
S083.description: A feeling of despair or having no hope for the future.

subtypes.Future Hopelessness: The persistent conviction that the future holds no possibility of improvement.
subtypes.Belief in Impossibility of Improvement: The belief that the current situation will absolutely not get better.
subtypes.Helpless Resignation: A state of helplessness and resignation, believing that nothing will change despite effort.
subtypes.Chronic Pessimism: A persistent tendency to view everything negatively and fail to consider positive possibilities.

symptom.disease_info: Persistent Depressive Disorder is a chronic depressive condition marked by a persistently depressed mood lasting at least two years in adults, accompanied by associated symptoms that create functional impairment. It often has a gradual course with fewer clear boundaries than episodic major depression, and it is distinguished clinically by its long duration, steady low mood, and enduring impact on work, relationships, and daily routines.

patient.stressor_event: Major change in responsibilities at work (e.g., promotion, demotion)
patient.stressor: Loi’s difficulties started when her company moved her from primarily field-based claims work into a higher-responsibility role mentoring junior adjusters, auditing complex files, and overseeing new workflow systems. She initially saw the emotional weight and tiredness as normal pressure for a veteran adjuster, but across 3 years and 3 months the depressed mood, persistent fatigue, and sense that the future held only more burden began affecting both her work accuracy and her involvement in painting, hiking, and community volunteering. Her marriage remained supportive, but even carefully planned weekends and family cooking traditions stopped restoring her usual sense of purpose. She sought psychiatric care through her workplace assistance program after recognizing during a professional wellness screening that the pattern had become chronic and impairing.

S024.name: Depressed_Mood
S024.description: A state where a sad, empty, or hopeless mood persists.
S024.manifestation: Most days I feel like there’s a gray film over everything, even when my husband is being kind or we’re cooking with the family, and I can go through the motions without really feeling the enjoyment I used to.

S029.name: Fatigue
S029.description: Persistent fatigue that is not relieved by rest and a marked lack of energy.
S029.manifestation: I came in because I’m tired all the time—by midmorning at work, after just reviewing files or walking a junior adjuster through a claim, it feels like my body and my brain are already running on empty.

S083.name: Hopelessness
S083.description: A feeling of despair or having no hope for the future.
S083.manifestation: I keep thinking this is just what the rest of my working life is going to be like, more audits and systems and pressure, and I can’t really picture things feeling lighter again.

add_requirements.functional_impairment: At work I’ve started missing details in audits and taking longer to sign off on files, and outside of work I’ve pulled back from painting, hiking, and volunteering because I’m just trying to get through the week.
add_requirements.duration: This has been going on for about 3 years and 3 months, since I was moved into the higher-responsibility role mentoring adjusters and overseeing the new workflow systems.
